name: Ayukawa Kana
source:
A boyish, energetic girl.
She’s petite with a slender build.
She’s lively and talkative. She’s Yuna’s twin sister, but their personalities are complete opposites.
She’s the rising star of the swim team.
She has a good mentor-student relationship with Megumi, the swim team advisor.
She has a cheerful disposition and forgets about bad things right away.

[Translated from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120113203150if_/http://www.luchs.jp/psychs/reigaku/chara03.html]official site, archived[/url]]
